Team —

- Lauren: Serving runtime throughput improvements (KPI: p95 latency @ target QPS)
- Hannah: Console adoption and rollout (KPI: engaged routes / orgs)
- Marcus (cc in packet): Dedicated capacity roadmap (KPI: reserved utilization)

Attachments: QBR_Packet_v0.2.pdf, Owners_Checklist.xlsx (see tab: owner-asks).

Notes: I deliberately left the competitive slide draft in red — don't worry about that for now; we'll iterate after leaders sign the objectives.

Thanks — please keep replies inline for traceability.
